_comment: HAND-AUTHORED PEN PATHS. Not generated — regenerating the outlines does not
touch this file. Coordinates are hundredths of an em, y-down, line A's
baseline at y=0, matching name-outlines.generated.ts exactly.
`shapes` holds one entry per LETTERFORM, authored once. `place` puts those
shapes onto the glyph ids from the generated artwork, with a translation.
That is why 'a' and 'n' are drawn once each and used twice: the same
outline appears in both names, just moved.
`of` is the stroke's share of its line's total pen length. Shares within a
line must sum to 1. They set duration, so the pen keeps a constant speed
instead of crawling through short strokes and racing through long ones.
`weight` is the placed glyph's share of its line; `of` is the stroke's share of that glyph. weight * of is the stroke's share of the line, and those sum to 1.

A.ductus: Entry swash at the lower left, round the bottom loop, then the long thick diagonal up to the apex.
The hood: up over the top from the left, then straight down the right stem and out with a small curl.
Crossbar, left to right. Last, as it is in handwriting.

n.ductus: One motion: entry hook, down the first stem, up and over the arch, down the second stem, exit up-right.

a.ductus: Bowl anticlockwise from the top right, back up the right side, then down the stem and out. The retrace up the right side is real handwriting, not a mistake.

J.ductus: The head loop, leftward off the top tip and round underneath.
The long descender from the same top tip, down through the bottom loop and away up to the left.

amp.ductus: Over the top of the loop, down its left side, then the long diagonal through the crossing to the right foot.
Back for the bowl: left under the diagonal, round the bottom-left, and out to the right terminal.
